notes: Automated ATS interview-scheduling invite sent on a recruiter's behalf.

email.subject: Schedule your interview with Example Corp
email.bodyText:
Hi Candidate,

Neha Verma from Example Corp would like to schedule a 45-minute technical interview with you for the Data Engineer role.

Please choose a time that works for you using the link below:
https://example.com/schedule

If none of the slots work, reply to this email and Neha will help.

Thanks,
Example Corp Recruiting
